subject: Heating at 14 Aldren Court, Flat 2
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I write regarding the heating and hot water at 14 Aldren Court, which have not worked since Saturday. I was told that an engineer would attend on Tuesday, but I have heard nothing further.

I am eighty-one and the flat is becoming rather cold in the evenings. I should be grateful to know when the repair will take place.

Yours faithfully,

Grace Okonjo (Mrs)
Flat 2

subject: Invoice 4471
body: Please find attached invoice 4471 for the September service visits. Payment terms 30 days.
